inputs: mark price klines for funding valuation
data.quality_policy: fail before PnL on corrupt ZIP, hash mismatch, invalid or duplicate row, non-contiguous required 5m series, missing archive, or missing feature, execution, or funding valuation data
data.boundary_note: all observations end before the 2026-07-30 forward boundary and remain D0 development evidence

schedule.decision_time: last millisecond before each frozen Monday 00:00 UTC rebalance boundary
schedule.base_entry_time: Monday 00:05 UTC after one complete 5m processing bar
schedule.hold: seven calendar days from each scenario's actual entry
schedule.overlap: weekly portfolios are contiguous and non-overlapping within each execution scenario

features.skip: exclude the most recent 24 hours before each rebalance
features.beta_window: 30 calendar days ending at the start boundary of the 28-day momentum interval; it does not overlap the momentum outcome window
features.beta_model: OLS alpha and beta of alt 5m close-to-close log returns on BTC returns
features.residual_scale: sample standard deviation of OLS residuals in the beta window
features.momentum_score: alt 28-day log return minus frozen beta times BTC 28-day log return, divided by residual scale times square root of 8064
features.liquidity_measure: sum quote volume over 30 days ending immediately before the rebalance boundary
features.capacity_measure: minimum quote volume over the 12 complete 5m bars ending immediately before the rebalance boundary
features.btc_trend_regime: sign of the known BTC 28-day return used in the score

portfolio.long_selection: three highest residual momentum scores among the 12 most liquid alts
portfolio.short_selection: three lowest residual momentum scores among the 12 most liquid alts
portfolio.sleeve_weights: inverse frozen residual volatility, normalized to alt longs +0.5 and alt shorts -0.5
portfolio.btc_hedge: negative of selected alt frozen beta exposure
portfolio.normalization: divide all signed alt and BTC hedge weights by total absolute weight
portfolio.capacity_rule: reference gross notional times absolute normalized leg weight must not exceed 2% of the leg's frozen capacity measure; otherwise skip the entire weekly portfolio
portfolio.turnover_rule: each weekly portfolio is fully closed and reopened; no optimistic netting is applied when a symbol remains selected

execution.fees: charge every alt and BTC hedge entry and exit fill notional
execution.funding: include every realized funding transfer with leg_entry_time <= funding_time < leg_exit_time, valued at the mark-price 5m open at funding_time
execution.live_authorization: PAPER_ONLY; no live orders are authorized

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a point-in-time full-universe replication and sub-minute execution replay; not eligible for live trading
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any lookback, skip, rebalance interval, rank count, weighting, or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.prohibited_claim: independent out-of-sample profitability or live-trading value
interpretation.known_bias: the fixed 16-symbol survivor panel cannot support a deployable universe claim
interpretation.independence_rule: the weekly portfolio is the observation unit; constituent legs are never counted as independent trades
interpretation.anti_concentration_rule: no single alt may contribute more than 25% of all positive alt-symbol contribution
